prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity desktop website dashboard mockup at 1536x1024 titled "Peak Unemployment". Airport wayfinding and departures-board art direction, warm gray #f4f2eb background, near black #252a2d typography, restrained saturated yellow #e6c753 navigation bands. Humanist sans typography, enormous title, strict destination-like rows, generous editorial spacing, small geometric pictograms only. Polished complete website mockup, crisp readable text.
Layout: yellow top navigation band with Overview, Journey, Activity, Geography, Explorer, Methodology. Enormous headline "Peak Unemployment" and exact tagline "Because apparently even unemployment needs KPIs." Visible small label "SYNTHETIC DEMO · 2026-10-15". Cohort filter row with Year / All years, Role / All roles, Location / All locations, Clear filters.
Main analytical area: "01 / Current status" with subtitle "Where applications stand today". Airport destination rows arranged as an interactive current-status route with a selected Applied row and detail pane to right. Current-status counts: Total tracked 48, Discovered 5, Preparing 4, Applied 16, Recruiter Screen 4, Interview 3, Technical 2, Final 1, Offer 1. Rejected 10 must branch separately from Total tracked, and Unknown 2 must appear separately. Display progression-like ordered labels only as a taxonomy of CURRENT statuses; explicitly label "Current states, not historical movement". Do not depict historical conversion, funnel attrition, movement counts or imply every record passed earlier stages. Detail panel title "Applied" with oversized 16, "applications currently in this status" and "Awaiting an update".
Lower analytical bays preview a horizontal bar chart with accurate current-status counts and a compact geography table with simple "Location" / "Applications" headings and neutral em-dash placeholder cells rather than invented location data. Section labels "02 / Status distribution" and "03 / Geography". Strong precise typography, clear rules and subtle numeric alignment, squared corners, disciplined black-and-yellow wayfinding language. No actual airplanes, photographs, textures, gradients, 3D, browser chrome, giant decorative icons, response rates, conversions, fabricated trends, or generic rounded SaaS cards.
